title: Vision-loop critique finding
description: One finding emitted at Stage 5 (visual critique) of the svg-figure-maker workflow.

id.description: Unique finding ID within a critique pass.

severity.description: 'fail' blocks delivery; 'warn' is non-blocking but should be addressed; 'info' is observational.

category.description: Critique category — keyed to the vision-loop checklist.

principle_ref.description: Section reference into figure_design_principles.md (e.g., '§6.2', '§3.2', '§6.2.1') or 'N/A' if not directly mapped. Any depth of subsection is allowed.

location.description: Where in the SVG the issue lives.

group_id.description: The id of the enclosing <g> group, if applicable.

element_selector.description: CSS/XPath-style selector for the offending element.

coords.description: [x, y] or [x, y, width, height] in viewBox units.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete action to resolve the finding.

tell.description: Generative-Artifact Tell Pass discriminator. Present only on category='generative_tell' findings. See ../../shared/references/generative_artifact_tells.md. Categorical tells (T1–T4) dominate; aesthetic signals (T6) are weak and two-sided.

id.description: Tell identifier: T1 lexical validity, T2 glyph integrity, T3 encoding↔printed-value, T4 physical/pathway plausibility (T1–T4 categorical), T5 axis/label coherence, T6 default-template feel (T5–T6 graded).

score.description: 0 = no tell observed; 1 = weak/ordinary; 2 = decisive tell. A categorical tell scored 2 forces regenerate. Thresholds provisional/uncalibrated.

categorical.description: True for T1–T4 (dominant, auto-fail at score 2); false for T5–T6 (graded, never dispositive).

justification.description: One-line justification quoting what was seen in the raster (or 'not observed').
